wave.summary: Fixed all three reproduced findings in one worktree. (F1) Exported SUBJECT_LABELS/DIFFICULTY_LABELS from PromptCard.tsx (were module-private); FavoritesView.tsx now imports and uses both maps instead of raw enum values (was rendering e.g. REALESTATE via .tag-chip uppercase), and its serial-tag now renders as 'No {serial}' matching the generator card format — the prior fixer's time-band chip was left untouched. (F4) PromptCard's Copy handler now uses a tri-state (idle/copied/failed): missing navigator.clipboard.writeText or a rejected write flips the button to 'Copy failed' instead of silently doing nothing. FavoritesView's own Copy handler shared the same silent-fallthrough bug (guarded optional chain with a no-op .catch), so it got the same fix, reusing its existing 1500ms setTimeout reset pattern for a 'Copy failed' state alongside the existing 'Copied!' one. (F7) Added one test to App.test.tsx that switches to the Brain Scout tab, types a phrase into the seed-idea input (via native-setter + input-event dispatch since it's a controlled input), submits the form, and asserts 4 .ladder-rung + 3 .remix-card cards render with the phrase verbatim in the first rung's text. All pre-existing tests were left unchanged. Verified with `npx vitest run` (117/117 passing, up from 116) and `npx tsc -b` (clean, no output). Note: had to symlink node_modules from the target repo into the worktree to run the suite at all (the worktree had no node_modules of its own) — this symlink is untracked/uncommitted and does not appear in the commit.
